title: feat(spec)!: the AI-door confirmation rule binds every AI door, the in-app assistant included
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9TXr7V8fVZuv7LtSLY4SNCD)_
Fixes #33808

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: semantic

## 维护者速读

1. **改了什么**：AI 入口确认契约（`ai-service.ts`）写明：规则对所有 AI 入口生效，包括应用内助手；应用内助手保留自己的确认卡和收件箱，并写明三点：只有本人能同意、只认登录状态、同意后按本人权限重查再执行。`IAIService` 的三个待批成员的注释同步写明这三点，签名不变。
2. **为什么改**：#33689 Q1 已裁 B（「B 同一规则，两套流程暂留」）。契约原来只写了 MCP 两个工具，应用内助手是一条绕过同一个「需要确认」声明的旁路。
3. **风险与回滚**：属于收紧（breaking，实现落地时生效）：管理员不能再替别人批应用内的待批动作，API key/token 也不能批。本次发版不改变任何入口的行为，只改契约文字、固定测试，并登记一条升级提示（semantic 迁移条目）。回滚即还原这两个提交。
4. **先看**：`packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts` 新增的「The in-app assistant door」一节（三点、对队列里每一项都生效、未接通则不提供该动作）；`.changeset/33808-ai-door-confirmation-in-app.md` 的 BREAKING 说明与 FROM/TO；新迁移条目 `18.in-app-pending-action-decided-by-person.ts`。
5. **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/contracts/action-confirmation-contract.pin.test.ts src/contracts/ai-service.test.ts`，预期 46 个测试全绿（换回 main 的契约文字时新增的 4 个转红）。
6. **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（落地前席位做一次契约档复核）。

## What changes

`packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts`, contract text only; no export, type or signature moves.

- **Rule 1** of the confirmation contract (the docblock of `AI_ACTION_CONFIRMATION_CAPABILITY`) now covers EVERY AI door that starts an action declaring `ai.requiresConfirmation: true`: the MCP `run_action` and `resume_run` tools and the in-app assistant's action tools (ADR-0011's actions-as-tools runtime). Rules 2 to 4 are named as the MCP doors' channel; rules 5 and 6 bind the in-app door as written.
- **New section, "The in-app assistant door: the same rule, its own channel"**, citing ruling record 6893484458 on #33689 (「B 同一规则，两套流程暂留」). The door asks through the pending-action queue of `IAIService` (inline pending-approval card plus inbox, the tool answers `pending_approval`); when that channel is not wired it does not offer a declared-gated action as a tool at all. Its three points:
  1. **Who decides:** only the person the call ran as. Holding `ai:approve` or any other permission does not let another user decide; a second approver uses the existing `held` outcome (the approvals engine).
  2. **Which credential:** the approve and reject doors take a person's signed-in session to the app and nothing else; an API key, token, other service credential or AI identity is refused, whoever it resolves to.
  3. **As whom it runs:** as that person, never as a synthetic AI principal, every gate and permission re-checked at the moment of approval; a refusal there runs nothing and the row is `failed`.
  Neither the model's own confirmation nor the caller's `confirm` counts.
- **Every queued item (review S1):** one sentence in the in-app section: the three points bind EVERY item in the in-app queue, whichever trigger queued it (the declared flag or the destructive heuristic), because a pending row does not record why it was queued and the queue has one decider rule; an administrator who must also approve does so through `held`. Rule 1's reach for the MCP doors is unchanged (the declared flag alone).
- **Its bounds:** the in-app queue and `IActionConfirmationService` stay two seams (merging them was not ruled; #33806).
- **When it binds:** the in-app door's FROM half is stated (today any `ai:approve` holder decides, the routes take whatever credential they authenticate, an approved item goes through ADR-0011's pre-registered dispatcher), beside the MCP doors' existing one.
- **`IAIService.proposePendingAction` / `approvePendingAction` / `rejectPendingAction`** stay, signatures unchanged; each docblock now states the points that bind it (`approvePendingAction`: `actorId` must be the row's `proposed_by`, the calling door admits only a signed-in session, the re-dispatch runs as that person with every gate re-checked, a second approver uses `held`). `proposePendingAction` also names `ai.requiresConfirmation: true` as a queueing trigger, as ADR-0011's table already does.
- `.changeset/33808-ai-door-confirmation-in-app.md` (review M1): `feat(spec)!:`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` (nothing widens), `Metadata-protocol: semantic`, `@objectstack/spec` minor, the BREAKING-when-implemented banner and the ADR-0087 marker `registered in-app-pending-action-decided-by-person`, matching the #33689 changeset for the same contract.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.in-app-pending-action-decided-by-person.ts`: the new semantic entry that marker names, written conditionally like `action-requires-confirmation-elicited`, so the upgrade guide and `os migrate meta` carry the notice.
- Generated artifacts: none move. `check:generated --fix` built `packages/spec` itself and answered "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date"; the registry is written at build time and git-ignored.

Not here, by the card: `docs/adr/**` (ADR-0011's amendment note already says the three changes land through #33808), the cloud approve and reject routes (#33809), the seam merge (#33806), the runtime and MCP switch (the implementing card).

## Why

#33689 Q1 was ruled B: 「新规则对所有 AI 入口生效：只有本人、在登录状态下能同意，同意后按本人权限重查再执行。应用内确认卡保留，管理员代批改走暂挂审批。」 Until the contract says so, the in-app door is a side path around a declared confirmation gate.

## First-party exposure of the narrowing (read only, at merge base 895783a1)

The narrowing lands with the implementing change; nothing below moves in this PR.

- **ui inbox and in-chat card:** 15 source files (51 with tests) under `ui/apps` and `ui/packages` name the pending-action seam (`git grep -l -E 'pending-actions|PendingActions|usePendingActions|useHitlInChat|AiPendingAction'`, CHANGELOGs and locale bundles excluded). The card's count of 21 used a different pattern; this one is reproducible. Two of them DECIDE: `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/usePendingActions.ts` (approve :385, reject :396) and `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useHitlInChat.ts` (:223-231). Both POST with `credentials: 'include'` (the session cookie) and merge caller-supplied `headers`, documented as possibly carrying `Authorization`. Exposed once enforced: an inbox operator deciding another user's item is refused, and a host that authenticates the inbox by bearer only is refused.
- **Client SDK:** `client.ai.pendingActions.approve` / `reject` (`packages/client/src/index.ts` :7744-7765); its docblock says deciding takes `ai:approve`. An SDK caller on an API key or token is refused once enforced. Docs mirror: `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx` :418-426.
- **examples:** `examples/app-todo/src/actions/task.actions.ts` :143-153 mentions the queue in comments; zero decision call sites.
- **skills:** `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` :163-166 says "an operator approves or rejects in Studio's AI Pending Actions inbox (or via `GET/POST /api/v1/ai/pending-actions/...`)" (the changeset's `Skills-docs:` line).

## Tests

- New, `packages/spec/src/contracts/action-confirmation-contract.pin.test.ts`: "the rule binds EVERY AI door, the in-app assistant included, through its own channel" (rule 1's new reach with the MCP-only reading as a negative control, the section heading, not-offered-when-unwired, the three points, the every-queued-item sentence with rule 1's declared-flag predicate as its control, the model's own confirmation, two seams, the in-app FROM half). The amended describe's header names it.
- New, `packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.test.ts`: a top-level describe pinning the three members' docblocks (one `it` per member), plus a control that `listPendingActions` carries none of the deciding points, so the docblock reader is shown not to answer every member alike.
- **Forced test edits: none.** Every existing assertion in both files passes unchanged.
- Reverse verification (one-off, no file kept): with `ai-service.ts` set to main's 895783a1 text, the four new member/section tests went red (`Tests 4 failed | 36 passed (40)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 1) and the `listPendingActions` control and every pre-existing test stayed green; restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, hash equal to HEAD's blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- After merge, ADR-0011's amendment note ("land through #33808") may want a pointer update: carrier, the skills lane.

## Follow-ups (from contract review 6897177404)

- **For the in-app door's implementing card:** it must refuse to queue an in-app item without the person the call ran as (`proposedBy`); `ProposePendingActionInput.proposedBy` stays optional in this PR (review flag 1, option A).
- **N1, implementing card:** say how a refused decision reaches the caller. `approvePendingAction`'s `failed` means an approved item whose execution failed, so a refusal of another user (and on `rejectPendingAction` likewise) has to be a throw; the docblocks could say so.
- **N2, implementing card:** an in-app item whose person never answers, or has left, stays `pending`, since only that person may reject it. The hand-off text leaves lapse to the host in words; the in-app text could say the same.
- **N3, a separate prose card:** `proposePendingAction`'s sentence still lists "has `confirmText`" as a danger signal, while `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` :153 says `confirmText` is dialog copy and not a destructive signal. Older than this PR and outside the card.

## Verification

Head is now 9a9adad0: a merge of `main` only (e71ecc1b, via `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`, no rebase, no force-push), made under the seat's K ≥ 15 landing rule because `main` had moved 15+ commits past the merge base. The figures below were taken at b091e451 (round 1 on top of 10b5d04b), on a worktree build of `@objectstack/spec` from that head. The PR's own diff is byte-identical: `git diff b091e451 9a9adad0` over the five PR files is empty, and `origin/main...9a9adad0` is still those five files, +294/−8.
